Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Field.Name: Current Year
Field.Description: The current calendar year (example: 2016).

Field.Name: Current Month
Field.Description: The current calendar month, with values 1 to 12 inclusive, January=1, etc.

Field.Name: Current Day
Field.Description: The current calendar day, with values 1 to 31 inclusive.

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version of this interface. Currently set to 1.

Field.Name: Sub-version
Field.Description: Sub-version of this interface. Currently set to 0.

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Directory Message
Message.Description: Whenever a complex order is added in the system for an underlying, the order is normalized and results in either the creation of a new complex strategy or is added to an existing strategy. A Complex Strategy Message containing the strategy definition will be sent.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: StrategyType
Field.Description: StrategyType value

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the Strategy, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the strategy. All legs in this strategy belong to this Underlying

Field.Name: Number Of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs in the strategy NOTE: Leg field offsets below are an equation, where “n” is the zero based leg number (0, 1, …)

Message.Name: Strategy Open Closed Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate when an strategy has completed the opening process and is now available for auto execution or when the option has closed and is no longer available for auto execution.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: Reflects the current eligibility for auto execution of the options security in the options market.

Message.Name: Strategy Trading Action Message
Message.Description: ISE uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a strategy within the ISE Options Market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the strategy on the ISE market.

Message.Name: Strategy Best Bid And Ask Update
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate when an strategy has completed the opening process and is now available for auto execution or when the option has closed and is no longer available for auto execution.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Strategy Directory Message.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: <space> = regular quote/autox eligible “X” = Pre-Open/Halted

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Best bid price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Bid Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer quantity on the bid side.

Field.Name: Bid ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the bid side.

Field.Name: Bid NTT Size
Field.Description: Limit Bid size that can’t be traded through.

Field.Name: Bid Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Bid side.

Field.Name: Bid NTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregated NTT Market Size on Bid Size.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: Best ask price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Ask Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer quantity on the ask side.

Field.Name: Ask ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the ask side.

Field.Name: Ask NTT Size
Field.Description: Limit Ask size that can’t be traded through.

Field.Name: Ask Market Size
Field.Description: Aggregate market quantity on Ask side.

Field.Name: Ask NTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregated NTT Market Size on Ask Size.

Message.Name: Strategy Best Bid Update
Message.Description: The options system will continuously calculate its best bid position for active strategies on the options market during the trading day. Whenever the best bid position changes on one side but not the other side, the options system will send its best bid update via this feed for the affected security.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Strategy Directory Message.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote Condition

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Best bid or ask price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits, the side determined by Message Type.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid or ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer Quantity on the bid or ask side.

Field.Name: ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the bid or ask side.

Field.Name: NTT Size
Field.Description: Limit size that can’t be traded through

Field.Name: Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size.

Field.Name: NTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregated NTT Market Size.

Message.Name: Strategy Best Ask Update
Message.Description: The options system will continuously calculate its best offer position for active strategies on the options market during the trading day. Whenever the best ask position changes on one side but not the other side, the options system will send its best ask update via this feed for the affected security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Strategy Directory Message.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote Condition

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Best bid or ask price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits, the side determined by Message Type.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid or ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time.

Field.Name: Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer Quantity on the bid or ask side.

Field.Name: ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the bid or ask side.

Field.Name: NTT Size
Field.Description: Limit size that can’t be traded through

Field.Name: Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size.

Field.Name: NTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregated NTT Market Size.

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Ticker Message
Message.Description: The ticker message is used to send real time trade information

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Complex StrategyDirectory Message.

Field.Name: Last Price
Field.Description: Most recent price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Last traded quantity.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Total traded quantity.

Field.Name: High
Field.Description: High price for the day.

Field.Name: Low
Field.Description: Low price for the day.

Field.Name: First
Field.Description: Opening price for the day

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Same value as the Trade Condition sent to OPRA for this trade. To obtain a list of Trade Conditions, refer to the NOTES below.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Option ID for this leg, valid for the trading day. The same ID as the corresponding Option in the Options Directory Message. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Leg ID
Field.Description: Leg identifier within this strategy. This is an exchange-assigned 0-based index. E.g. Nth leg has LegId=N-1.

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit strike price of the option. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type:

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the leg

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg Ratio

Value.Name: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process

Value.Name: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
